name: Charminar
description: Hyderabad landmark at the heart of the historic old city. Telangana Tourism identifies Charminar as a landmark built in 1591.
sourceNotes: Coordinates are a mapped monument point; the official tourism portal is the source for destination context.

name: Golconda Fort
description: Historic fort complex in Hyderabad and part of the state's identified heritage-tourism circuit.
sourceNotes: The state tourism policy lists Golconda Fort in the Hyderabad–Rangareddy–Medchal heritage cluster. The coordinate is a mapped fort reference point.

name: Ramappa Temple
description: The Kakatiya Rudreshwara (Ramappa) Temple at Palampet is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, inscribed in 2021.
sourceNotes: Coordinates are taken from the UNESCO World Heritage Centre map record.

name: Warangal Fort
description: Kakatiya-era fort precinct and one of the heritage destinations highlighted in Telangana's tourism planning.
sourceNotes: Coordinates are a public mapped reference point for the fort precinct.

name: Kuntala Waterfalls
description: Waterfall on the Kadem river, about 64 km from Adilabad according to the district administration's visitor information.
sourceNotes: Coordinates are a public reference point. Confirm local access and seasonal conditions with district authorities before travel.

name: Bhoodan Pochampally
description: Handloom destination associated with Pochampally Ikat weaving and included in Telangana's crafts-tourism planning.
sourceNotes: The marker is a town-centre reference, not a specific workshop or visitor entrance. Contact local operators for exact locations.
